chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Samurah, from Abu Sa'id, who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) rode out on the she-camel of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), so we went out with him walking until we reached the place of the fish sellers. He gathered them and then said: 'Do you know for what reason I have gathered you?' They said: 'No.' He said: 'Do not buy the Jirris, nor the Marmahi, nor the Tafi that floats on the water, and do not sell it.'

key_terms.الطَّافِي: The floating one (a type of fish that floats on water)
key_terms.بَغْلَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: The she-camel of the Messenger of Allah

ai.seo_question: What are the three types of fish prohibited for purchase and sale according to Imam Ali (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Istibsar records Imam Ali (peace be upon him) personally gathering fish sellers to prohibit the trade of Jirris, Marmahi, and Tafi, reflecting the early Shia emphasis on practical legal guidance in commercial markets. The specific identification of these fish types underscores the tradition's attention to distinguishing permissible (halal) from impermissible (haram) aquatic creatures based on their physical characteristics and habitat.
